Comment: Layer order from lowest to highest. A module may depend on modules in lower layers, and on same-layer modules as the layer's SameLayer policy allows. Paths are relative to the DrsFramework root; the longest matching path wins. The module graph must have no cycles.
SameLayerComment: SameLayer is 'Plugin' (the default: modules may depend on modules in their own plugin), 'Any' (any same-layer module; used for External, whose vendor plugins keep their own module structure) or 'None' (no same-layer dependencies). AllowedSameLayer lists the exceptions, as 'A -> B'.
TestModuleComment: Modules whose names end with TestModuleSuffix may also depend on any module in their own plugin, whatever the layer's SameLayer policy.
